symptom: A data view's microflow data source stored with FormValidations None (ako/TestApp Pages.OutputMappingButton dataView1, Forms$MicroflowSource.MicroflowSettings) was rewritten as All on describe → exec: Replaced page, the only difference on the page
cause: The data-source writer called microflowSettingsToGen with nil settings, which writes Mendix's defaults, and neither the grammar nor describe had a place for a data source's call settings
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLPage.g4 (dataSourceExprV3 MICROFLOW … actionSettingsV3?), mdl/visitor/visitor_page_v3.go + visitor_action_settings.go (data source takes FormValidations only), sdk/pages/pages_datasources.go (MicroflowSource.FormValidations), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go + cmd_alter_page.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (3 microflow-source sites), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_datasource.go, cmd_fragments.go; test mdl/executor/datasource_formvalidations_1729_test.go
insight: Tally every field of the shared element under each parent before choosing a syntax: Forms$MicroflowSettings under a data source held non-default values in FormValidations only (44 TestApp + 4 PedApp sources, every other setting default), so the data source reuses the action's `with ( … )` rule with one key allowed rather than a new property. Before the grammar change `DataSource: microflow M.F with (…)` parsed without error as the deprecated `microflow M.F` ACTION form and left the widget with no source — an alternative that fails in one rule can succeed in a fallback rule, so a parse test with no errors proves nothing about which rule took it
